background: Wells Fargo & Company is the holding company of one of the four largest US banks, with consumer banking and lending, commercial banking, corporate and investment banking and wealth management, and a long regulatory remediation behind it.
synthesis: Rated A on average across all three, the weakest of them at A-, all on a stable outlook after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 29 Sep 2026 that ended its positive outlook. CET1 of 10.3% is in the bottom quarter of US banks, the weak spot, while leverage of 5.8% is at the peer median and LCR of 122% above it. Since 30 Jun 2025 CET1 has fallen 0.9 points and leverage 0.9 points, in figures to 30 Sep 2026.
